evals.name: bug-fix-pagination
evals.prompt: I fixed a bug in the job filtering where the pagination wasn't working correctly across different filters. I modified the API endpoint to properly handle offset/limit parameters and updated the tests. Can you generate a PR description?
evals.expected_output: A structured PR description that explains the pagination bug, what files were changed (API route, test file), testing approach, and why this matters for users. Should include code references.

assertions.name: has-what-section
assertions.description: Description includes a clear 'What' section summarizing the fix

assertions.name: has-why-section
assertions.description: Description includes a 'Why' section explaining the bug impact

assertions.name: has-testing-guidance
assertions.description: Description provides clear testing instructions for reviewers

assertions.name: mentions-files-changed
assertions.description: Description references specific files that were modified (API endpoint, tests)

assertions.name: explains-user-impact
assertions.description: Description explains why this bug fix matters to users

evals.name: feature-export-jobs
evals.prompt: I added CSV export functionality to the job tracker. Users can now download their jobs as a CSV file. I created a new API endpoint /api/jobs/export, added export utilities, and included tests. Please write a PR description that explains this feature.
evals.expected_output: PR description covering: what the feature does, why it's useful (user requested feature), files changed (new endpoint, utilities, tests), how to test it (visit jobs page, click export button), and any relevant notes about CSV formatting or dependencies.

assertions.name: clear-feature-summary
assertions.description: Description clearly explains what the CSV export feature does

assertions.name: explains-user-benefit
assertions.description: Description explains why users would want this feature

assertions.name: lists-new-files
assertions.description: Description identifies new files created (API endpoint, utilities) vs modified

assertions.name: testing-steps-provided
assertions.description: Description includes concrete steps to test the export functionality

assertions.name: considers-csv-details
assertions.description: Description mentions relevant technical details like CSV format or dependencies

evals.name: refactor-auth-middleware
evals.prompt: I refactored the authentication middleware to be more modular and support multiple auth strategies. This involved extracting common auth logic into a utility function, updating the auth context to use hooks, and migrating existing code to use the new pattern. Generate a comprehensive PR description.
evals.expected_output: PR description that emphasizes the architectural improvement, explains the new structure, lists all affected files (auth context, middleware, components using auth), testing approach (existing tests should pass, verify auth still works), and notes about the migration strategy for this and future auth work.

assertions.name: explains-architectural-change
assertions.description: Description explains the architectural improvement and new structure

assertions.name: identifies-scope
assertions.description: Description makes clear which files are affected by the refactoring

assertions.name: addresses-backward-compatibility
assertions.description: Description addresses whether existing code still works (migration strategy)

assertions.name: provides-testing-approach
assertions.description: Description explains how to verify the refactoring didn't break functionality

assertions.name: future-oriented
assertions.description: Description mentions benefits for future work (e.g., easier to add new auth strategies)
